sections.title: What it is
sections.body: After a successful attack, roll the listed weapon, spell, or adversary damage dice and compare the total to thresholds when needed.

sections.title: How it works
sections.body: Use after a hit or when a feature calls for damage.

items: Use after a hit or when a feature calls for damage.
After the attack succeeds. Roll the listed damage, then compare it to the target's thresholds or stat block instructions.
